name: Haidenhof
beschreibung:
Perched on the sunny slope of the Schlossberg above Lienz, Haidenhof offers comfortable rooms with breathtaking views of the surrounding peaks alongside wholesome traditional Tyrolean cuisine.

The Schlossbergbahn lift on Hochstein, the historic center of Lienz, and scenic trails are right on the doorstep.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Gasthof Haidenhof in Lienz boasts a magnificent panoramic setting facing the Lienz Dolomites.
